description: POST /v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId/resend - replays a retained delivery's stored payload unchanged to its original endpoint, which must still be enabled and subscribed to the event type (404 webhook_no_enabled_endpoints otherwise). Answers 202; the resend rate limits of retry-webhook apply (409/429 with a code). Requires an API key (sk_*).
name: webhooks_resend_delivery
title: Resend webhook delivery
